en.title: Talaq Procedure in Bangladesh
en.directAnswer: For a Muslim husband, talaq is not only a spoken statement. Section 7 of the Muslim Family Laws Ordinance requires written notice to the Chairman after pronouncement and a copy to the wife. The law also contains a waiting and reconciliation framework before the talaq becomes effective.

atAGlance.legalBasis: Muslim Family Laws Ordinance, 1961, section 7; Muslim Marriages and Divorces (Registration) Act, 1974.

en.lawMeaning: The exact effective date and procedure must be calculated from the current section 7 and the facts, including pregnancy where relevant. This page gives a general route. A person’s exact rights can change because of facts, documents, deadlines, legal status, court orders or later amendments.
steps: Do not rely only on an oral statement.
Send notice to the legally specified Chairman and copy to the wife.
Deal separately with dower, maintenance and children.
evidence: Marriage record; talaq notice; proof of service; correspondence; divorce registration; dower information.
en.simpleExample: A husband says “talaq” during an argument but sends no statutory notice. The couple should not assume that this alone completed the legal process.
commonMistakes: Common mistakes: no proof of service.
Common mistakes: assuming marriage issues about children or dower disappear automatically..
